answer: Faking identities means posting real stake per sybil and risking slashing on failed audits, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents pay only a small anchor fee. Each agent stakes a violet-bonded deposit to a shared registry, and every epoch a rotating falcon committee randomly audits a sample of nodes, requiring them to sign a fresh challenge with hardware-anchored keys. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
